OAuth setup

This extension uses only the Google Photos Picker read-only scope. It has no client secret and no server.

1. Fixed extension ID

Create a Google OAuth client of type Chrome Extension with this Item ID:

Loading…

2. Current OAuth client

Loading…

3. Configure and rebuild

From the source folder, run:

npm run configure-oauth -- "YOUR_CLIENT_ID.apps.googleusercontent.com"
npm run build

Then click Reload for this extension on chrome://extensions or edge://extensions.
